title: The time axis is a calibration premise
question: Can identical samples yield different absolute decay and frequency under different clock labels?
finding: A wrong timebase changes fitted frequency and decay together without changing samples; an independently known reference can correct this synthetic clock error.

failedControls.outcome: accepted file format but wrong absolute physical parameters
four cases rejected without modifying raw input

limits: Generated PCM and timestamp fixtures are not a physical clock measurement
Independent reference frequency is an additional assumption; a same-clock generated tone is circular calibration
Header sample rate and reported device settings do not independently certify true sampling time
A constant reference tone reaches alpha0 search boundary; that flag is retained
